tickets.title: List the budget categories from the API
tickets.description:
The iOS and web clients hard-code the expense, income and savings categories, so a category added in `schemas/budget.py` (as Refunds was) never reaches them until each client ships. Add an endpoint that lists them.

## Acceptance criteria

- `GET /api/v1/budget/categories` returns `{"expenses": [...], "income": [...], "savings": [...]}`, each the values of its enum in declaration order
- The endpoint requires the API key, like every other budget route
- `openapi.yaml` documents it

tickets.title: Filter transactions by merchant
tickets.description: `GET /api/v1/budget/transactions` filters by date and category but not by merchant.
